plainText:
Zoe Martin is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is also credited by her birth name, Meredith Zeitlin. She is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Martin was born as Meredith Zeitlin. As an adult, she became a voice actress and worked on a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. She joined during and has notably voiced Angie, 's friend from the Pokémon Summer Academy; and Mairin, Alain's traveling companion from the Mega Evolution Specials. Martin currently resides in New York City, New York.
